Tesseract.js 6.0.1 (Apache-2.0), https://github.com/naptha/tesseract.js
Vendored browser and worker bundles from cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/tesseract.js@6.0.1/dist/.
The camera reader downloads pinned Tesseract.js-core 6.0.0 and English trained data 1.0.0 from jsDelivr on first use. Tag images are processed in the browser and are not uploaded.
